Drift read the changelog ([CHANGES.rst](https://github.com/zopefoundation/zope.interface/blob/master/CHANGES.rst)) for zope-interface 8.6.0 and found nothing in it that announces a breaking change. That is weaker than a clean API comparison: it means nothing was flagged, not that nothing broke.
